title: Sequential Contrastive and Deep Learning Models to Identify Selective Butyrylcholinesterase Inhibitors
summary: Contrastive/deep-learning virtual screen of 5.37m compounds; 7 of 20 tested compounds are selective BChE inhibitors. Two assay replicates; in-vitro hit evidence only, no in-vivo/clinical result. The result is limited to this study and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
